description: UAM-P represents the changing global upper atmosphere and near-Earth plasma. Its thermospheric, ionospheric-protonospheric and electric-field components cover a broad altitude range and allow numerical or empirical neutral conditions. The resource is documented by NASA Community Coordinated Modeling Center (metadata publisher; developer not specified). The documented physical domain is Global Ionosphere, Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. Only the web documentation and method were verified. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The source page does not provide a present executable-access link. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue.
